item.title: WVSSAC Class AA Boys Basketball State Tournament schedule
item.description: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. — Eight teams have qualified for the WVSSAC Class AA Boys Basketball State Tournament. The five-day, 28-game event will begin on March 17 at the Charleston Coliseum and Convention Center. Radio broadcasts of all state tournament games will air on the MetroNews Radio Network and will be streamed at wvmetronews.com.
